_about: Field terms for F94, same shape as papers/glossary.json.

latent-variable.definition: a quantity that was not measured and is inferred because several measured columns of a table vary together as if driven by it
latent-variable.excludes: a measured column, and any claim that the inferred quantity is a cause

parallel-analysis.definition: a way to count the hidden variables in a table: keep only those components whose strength exceeds what the same analysis gives on random data of the same size
parallel-analysis.excludes: a test of what the components mean, and any guarantee when the rows of the table depend on each other

red-noise.definition: random data in which each value stays close to the one before it, so the series drifts slowly; here each column is drawn on its own with a lag-one autocorrelation of 0.8, so no structure is shared between columns
red-noise.excludes: white noise, where successive values are unrelated, and any series with a real shared driver

pca.definition: a decomposition of a table into uncorrelated directions ordered by how much of the table's variation each carries
pca.excludes: a method that says whether a direction is real or noise

ica.definition: a decomposition that rotates the main directions of a table until the resulting components are as statistically independent as possible
ica.excludes: a method working in a different subspace from principal component analysis; it rotates the same one

sparse-autoencoder.definition: a small neural network trained to rebuild its input through a layer in which only a few units are active at once, so each unit tends to stand for one pattern; it can represent patterns a linear method cannot
sparse-autoencoder.excludes: a network trained on labels, and any guarantee that a unit matches one real-world quantity

noise-share.definition: the fraction of each column's variance that is independent noise and so carries no trace of the planted variables
noise-share.excludes: measurement error in the labels used for the outside checks

oracle-share.definition: the share of planted variables that the best linear predictor from all columns recovers at the same threshold the tool is scored on; no linear method can do better, so it is the ceiling
oracle-share.excludes: the ceiling for nonlinear methods given unlimited data

eta-squared.definition: the share of a quantity's variance that lies between groups, here between the five scripted states; 0 means the groups do not differ and 1 means the groups explain everything
eta-squared.excludes: a statement about which groups differ or in which direction

benjamini-hochberg.definition: an adjustment of a set of p values that holds the expected share of false discoveries among the results called significant at a chosen level
benjamini-hochberg.excludes: a guarantee that no result in the set is a false discovery
